# Dink for the Roots

> A pickleball fundraising tournament for indigenous communities. Saturday, December 5, 2026, at Pickle Park, Roxas Extension, Digos City. ₱1,200 per player. Davao del Sur residents only. Registration closes November 20, 2026, 11:59 PM.

Dink for the Roots is a one-day pickleball fundraising tournament for indigenous communities.
The event is on Saturday, December 5, 2026.
The venue is Pickle Park, Roxas Extension, Digos City, Davao del Sur, Philippines.

The tournament is exclusive to residents of Davao del Sur.

Registration uses one form per player.
Each player pays ₱1,200 and names a partner.
Each player registers separately.
Each player uploads a valid ID photo. A club name is optional.
Registration closes on November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM (Asia/Manila). After the cut-off, the form is closed.

## Categories

- Novice Men's Doubles: 20 pairs
- Novice Women's Doubles: 20 pairs
- Novice Mixed Doubles: 20 pairs
- Rookie Mixed Doubles: 20 pairs

Slots count players. Each category has 40 player slots.

## Inclusions

Every player gets:

- Event T-shirt
- Surprise freebies
- Raffle entry
- One-time light snacks
- Bottled water
- Drawstring bag
- Sweat towel

## Prizes

Each of the 4 categories awards the same prizes:

- Champion: ₱5,000
- Silver: ₱3,000
- Bronze: ₱2,000

## Partners

- Make Them Visible: Empowering Indigenous Community
- Circle of Care: "Step that Matters" (Community Service, Women Empowerment, Mental Wellness)

## Links

- [Dink for the Roots](https://dinkfortheroots.redirectme.net/): Event details, categories, prizes, and partners.
- [Register a player](https://dinkfortheroots.redirectme.net/#register): Registration form for one player.
